name: SM_Prop_Brazier_Standing_01
dresses: standing fire basket, 0.72 x 0.70 x 0.99 m: three twisted square forged legs with beaten feet, collar and stretcher ring, a basket of ten flaring straps riveted to three hoops over an ash pan, a heaped bed of charcoal with ash on the tops and live embers in the gaps (emissive mask)

fit.socket: flame socket: [0.0, 0.0, 0.97], on top of the coals

emissive.type: flame, done in engine (no flame mesh in the FBX)
emissive.note: point light 15 cm above the socket, soft radius 12 cm, flicker 10-20 percent; T_Prop_Brazier_Standing_01_E is the ember bed mask (emissive = E * 120 nits, slow pulse 0.7-1.0; 0 when unlit); a dim red fill light inside the basket is still worth adding

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2, three review rounds (r5-r6). Last look still faults: charcoal lumps are faceted blobs that read slightly like dark rock in full sun (no long split-wood charcoal shapes); straps are even in width; rivets on the hoops are baked, not geometry; the ash pan is a plain dish. Ember glow (E) reads well in the dark.
